description: STAMFORD, CT  — On Wednesday, May 22, Stamford Democratic City Committee (DCC) delegates formally endorsed community advocate Eilish Collins Main as the Democratic nominee for the 146th State House District by a vote of 5-1.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Eilish Collins Main for CT, Christopher Brown, Treasurer
title: Press Release: Community Advocate and State Representative Candidate Eilish Collins Main Receives Endorsement From Stamford Democratic City Committee — Eilish Collins Main
